## What happened

Describe expected and actual behavior.

## Repro steps

1. Commands and inputs
2. Environment (OS, Node, pnpm, Rust)
3. Observable output or error

## Evidence

- Log lines / stack traces
- Artifacts or minimal reproducer

## Validation

- Normal path
- Failure path
- Edge/odd path
